Question
========
What is Sandel's main critique in The Tyranny of Merit?

Answerlist
----------
* The belief that success reflects merit creates hubris among winners and humiliation among losers
* Education has no effect on income
* Meritocracy has been fully achieved in the US
* Talent is evenly distributed

Solution
========
Sandel argues that meritocratic beliefs make winners see their success as their own doing and blame losers for their fate, fuelling populism.

Answerlist
----------
* True
* False
* False
* False
